نستبرئ (form X)
# نَسْتَبْرِئُ (nastabriʔu) /nas.tab.ri.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# نَسْتَبْرِئَ (nastabriʔa) /nas.tab.ri.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# نَسْتَبْرِئْ (nastabriʔ) /nas.tab.riʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
